name: KDP Beverage Concentrates Plant - St. Louis MO

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (8400 N Broadway, 38.7153/-90.2296) were wrong - that point is a residential/mixed area in north St. Louis city. Web research (Yelp, Manta, D&B, IndustryNet) confirms the real plant is Dr Pepper/Seven Up Manufacturing at 8900 Page Ave, Overland, MO 63114 - KDP's beverage concentrate/syrup plant, ~165 employees. Locked center at 38.6853/-90.3559.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck access is a private industrial drive off Page Ave on the NW; satellite z21 at the Page Ave junction shows only painted lane arrows, no barrier arm and no guard booth - open access drive shared with the adjacent property. Classified as no controlled gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at the entrance or anywhere along the access drive. Listed uncertain because Street View does not cover the private drive interior, but overhead imagery shows no booth structure.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate ~32 across three faces: SE/east apron ~10-12 doors (rail-served, trailers backed in), west face ~10-12, south face ~8. Low confidence on exact total - flagged.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on physically separate building faces (west apron vs SE/rail apron vs south face), consistent with separate shipping/receiving operations.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the south property boundary; rail cars observed at the SW corner adjacent to the building. Plant has rail siding access for inbound bulk ingredients.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site sits inside dense St. Louis County (Overland) industrial/retail fabric - bordered by Page Ave commercial corridor, I-170, and neighboring warehouses. Urban.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal access drive down the west side of the plant is long and can stack multiple trucks before reaching the dock aprons.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant building plus a secondary process/tank wing on the east; a separate small office building sits at the NW corner near Page Ave but is treated as ancillary, not a second facility cluster.
